bridgecafe_owner.text: Welcome to the Bridge Cafe. Everything here is made fresh, apart from the weather.
The Skye Bridge opened in 1995. Before that you took a ferry from Kyle of Lochalsh. The tolls were scrapped in 2004 after a long campaign.

then.text: You have had your tablet. The rest is for paying customers, and the bridge, apparently.

else.text: Cragchoughs nest on the sea cliffs. You will see them tumbling in the wind. Here, have some tablet while you watch.
